title: Beats 360 Cushion Kits and Apple Accessories See Early Prime Day Price Drops
content:
We're just a few days out from Prime Big Deal Days on October 6, and Amazon is already offering some savings on accessories including Anker chargers, Samsung monitors, and 4K TVs. We're also tracking deals on the new Mac mini, Mac Studio, and Apple Watch Ultra 4 this week.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

EARLY SAVINGS
Amazon Prime Big Deal Days


Amazon's fall Prime Day, called Prime Big Deal Days, is nearly upon us, and early discounts have already started appearing online. We're tracking big markdowns on TVs, monitors, charging accessories, and more in our original article, and be sure to keep an eye on the MacRumors front page for more Prime Big Deal Days news as the event gets closer.

Beats 360



  • What's the deal? Save on Beats 360 cushion kits and more

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

NEW
Beats 360 at Amazon

$40 OFF
Beats 360 Cushion Kits for $9.99


The new Beats 360 headphones were announced last week, and they're now available to order on Amazon and other retailers. They're available in Black, Cloud, plus a bundle where you can style the headphones however you'd like thanks to interchangeable ear cushions and headbands.

Alongside the launch, Beats announced that its Cushion Kits compatible with the Beats 360 are available for just $9.99 for the next month, down from $49.99. Stock on these has begun to dwindle since launch, so be sure to get in soon before they disappear.

Amazon recently introduced the first cash discounts on Apple's brand new Mac mini and Mac Studio, with discounts reaching up to $50 off original prices. All of these deals represent the first discounts on the new computers, which just launched last month.

The new Apple Watch Ultra 4 just launched last month, and Amazon is offering the first cash discounts on select models for the first time since their launch. You can get the Apple Watch Ultra 4 for $779.99, down from $799.00.
